command:change=$(find openspec/changes -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d ! -name archive)
base=$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main)
outside=$({ git diff --name-only "$base"; git ls-files -o --exclude-standard; } | sort -u | grep -v "^$change/" | grep -v '^\.gnomish-task/' || true)
[ -z "$outside" ] || { echo "$outside"; echo "the specify stage writes only under $change/ - restore the files above with: git checkout $base -- <file>"; exit 1; }

findings.message: Accessible-name collision breaks E2E steps: Playwright getByRole name matching is case-insensitive substring by default, and the handle name 'Move Moscow' is a substring of the remove button 'Remove Moscow' (en.json locations.removeLocation = "Remove {{city}}"). Tasks 6.1 reuse the existing step 'the list offers the action {string}' (locations_ui_e2e.steps.ts:108-115: getByRole("button", { name: actionName }) with no exact option) for 'Move Moscow'/'Move Almaty' in the 'Handle names the city and is large enough' scenario and the NFR-R3 outline. That locator matches two buttons, so the strict-mode toBeVisible fails. The new 'the list offers no action {string}' step and the 'handle locator by "Move <city>"' helper have the same problem. The tasks must require exact name matching (or a regex anchored at the start) for handle locators and must not reuse the substring step.

Task 3.1 claims `npx vitest run src/controller` stays green after adding moveLocation to LocationsContextValue, but controller/useLocations.test.tsx:19-32 ('should return exactly the documented members') asserts Object.keys(result.current) equals exactly [rows, locations, loadStatus, hasSaveFailed, addLocation, removeLocation, resetLocations]. Adding moveLocation breaks it, and no task updates that test.

Promised behaviour without an automated test, contradicting M1 ('100% of ... UX1–UX3 have at least one automated test'). (a) UX1 and the spec requirement 'Smooth reorder transitions' ('the dropped card MUST settle into its slot with an animation of the same duration') and NFR-A4 ('without a drop animation') have no test; M6 and the E2E scenarios only check the displaced Almaty card's transition while the card is picked up. (b) UX2 'keeps its width; the slot it leaves is held open until the drop' is not asserted; the UX2 step only checks that the x position is unchanged and box-shadow is set. (c) UX3/spec 'scrolling the page over a card ... keep working' has no scenario. Add E2E checks or narrow the promises.

Inaccurate claim about existing tests: task 6.2 and design D7 say 're-approve the 8 `list` examples of the existing outline "Screenshot of the <state> state ..."', but locations_ui_e2e.feature lines 118-123 hold 4 `list` examples (375/1024 × light/dark). The 8 figure is the baseline images across the chromium and mobile-chrome projects. Correct the wording.
